status: D96.11 local B.Cu-to-D28.11 candidate found; source conflict and D96.9 continuation require continuity

drawing_observation.observation: exact .009 sheet-3 detail proves D96.9 Q2 and D96.11 CLK2 leave on distinct conductors; D96.11 crosses D28.10-to-D96.10 without a junction dot. The full overview traces Q2 to D101 A0-A3 and CLK2 to D94.2.

component_observation.observation: registered component-side package fit fixes both pad identities; visible local top-side copper is partly hidden by D96 and adjacent parts and does not expose a unique remote destination

solder_observation.observation: The reflected package fit places D96.11 near (625,1994), within about 6 px of a native visible solder joint around (624,1988). An uninterrupted B.Cu line rises east from that joint, runs right around y1963, and descends to a filled joint around (849,1990), about 11 px from registered D28.11 at (839,1996). D96.9 near (625,2086) has no comparably clear local B.Cu departure. The D96.11-to-D28.11 pin match is strong but conditional on those joint centers; it conflicts with the separate exact-source clock and DRQ nets.

pin11_photo_route_review.visible_b_cu: Continuous narrow trace from the D96-side joint northeast to about (650,1963), east to about (820,1963), then southeast into the D28-side joint. The full native crop separates this line from the parallel runs above and below.
pin11_photo_route_review.independent_photo_check: Adjacent native solder tiles PXL_20260710_200509593.jpg and PXL_20260710_200514102.jpg cover board regions farther right; neither repeats the D96.11 and D28.11 joints. The route has one photographic view.
pin11_photo_route_review.source_conflict: Exact .009 sheet 3 places D96.11 CLK2 with D94.2/D99.9/R89.1, while D28.11 is the D93.38 DRQ/R94.1 input. The photographed B.Cu route would join these modeled nets if both physical pin registrations are correct. Do not merge or reroute the replica from photo alone.
pin11_photo_route_review.next_check: With power off, measure D96.11↔D28.11 directly, then each against D94.2, D99.9, D93.38, and R94.1. If the join is confirmed, inspect for a board modification or source/model pin-registration error before changing either net.
pin11_photo_route_review.native_pin_row_recheck: On the July solder crop (570,1870)-(950,2140), both mirrored opposite-side package rows have about 46 px vertical pitch. The D96 pin-14 row starts around y1858, making the fourth opposite-row contact pin11 near y1996; the visible route starts at (624,1988). D28 has pin1/5/6 anchors at y1859/2042/2088 on the other column, fixing its opposite row top pin14 near y1859 and fourth contact pin11 near y1997; the route ends at (849,1990). Adjacent pin10 contacts would be near y2042/2043, over 50 px from the route endpoints. This independent row count strengthens the physical pin identities, while the 6–11 px registration offsets and unmetered continuity remain.

non_promotion_basis: Both D96.9-to-D101 and D96.11-to-D94.2 are source-closed by the full overview. D96.9's owner continuation remains hidden. overview_observation.observation: D96.9 Q2 turns down and left to the shared D101 A0-A3 input conductor. D96.11 CLK2 turns upward to the conductor drawn from D94.2. The D96.11 line crosses D28.10-to-D96.10 without a junction dot.
